note: EX-0 is the remaining grandfathered gate-8 no-clause tail. It is closed to new entries and must shrink. EX-1..EX-5 entries are per-function B2 reclassifications; tools/check_contract_policy.ps1 validates each function/path against the source. Counts are the difference between pub fns and pub-with-clause fns reported by tools/coverage_scan.ps1.
source: readiness gate 8 (wave 208, refreshed 2026-10-31) + coverage_scan.ps1 run 2026-11-06; B2 per-function reclassification 2026-11-06 (ffi 4, thread 5, serialize 6, format 2, iter 54); nine format ANSI helpers moved to clauses

modules.rationale: Iterator protocol/adaptor methods; the iterator invariant plus next/collect semantics are the contract, and a clause would restate the protocol.
Terminal iterator consumer; total over the iterator and the callback carries the effect.
gate-8 no-clause tail; platform/OS preconditions are currently documented at the platform layer. Reclassify per function in B2 (expected EX-2 shims).
gate-8 no-clause tail; domain-closed numeric helpers where the remaining clause would be tautological. Reclassify per function in B2 (expected EX-1 totals).
Total sleep helper: negative durations are clamped to 0 and the timing postcondition is outside the clause language.
Total runtime predicate: the Bool identifies the main thread and no stronger postcondition is available.
Structured-concurrency primitive: the runtime/scope owns join semantics and the callback return is the result.
Total scheduler hint with no return value; the side effect is not modeled by the clause language.
Total sequential loop over [start, end); no precondition and the callback carries the effect.
Dynamic-loader shim: the OS loader defines success/failure and the Result carries the handle or error; a clause would restate the ABI.
Dynamic-loader symbol lookup shim: the OS loader and the Result define the contract; a clause would restate the ABI.
Total diagnostic helper with no return value; the only postcondition is a stderr write, which the clause language does not model.
Total deallocation primitive; the SafePtr owned/ptr fields are the ownership contract and the call has no return value to constrain.
Object member accessor; it delegates to the covered json_get_ref and the Option is the whole contract.
Generic Serialize dispatcher; the trait and the Result are the contract and no stronger postcondition is expressible.
Generic Deserialize parser; the Result encodes success/failure and the trait defines the value contract.
Object member accessor on JsonValue; the Option is the observable contract.
Total YAML serializer over a YamlValue; there is no partial behavior and the text is the whole result.
Mapping member accessor; the Option is the observable contract.
Total stdout helper with no return value; the only postcondition is the write, which the clause language does not model.
Total stdout line helper with no return value; the write is the whole observable effect and is not modeled.
